svg.title: AlgalPathogenRisk-ML research workflow with scientific decision gates
svg.desc: Vertical research pipeline from biological question to research decision. Six validation gates each branch to a stopping outcome such as STOP, EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS ONLY, DATA INSUFFICIENT, BIOLOGICAL VALIDATION REQUIRED, UNCALIBRATED SCORES or SCENARIO ANALYSIS ONLY. A right-hand column names the repository modules that implement each stage. The pathogen-risk path ends at Gate 3 for GSE128981 because the dataset has no outcome labels.
svg.text: AlgalPathogenRisk-ML: research workflow and decision gates
Scientific pipeline (left) · stopping outcomes (centre) · implementing repository modules (right)
Batch confounded or too few replicates
log2-FPKM OLS + BH FDR; count DE needs counts
No infection / collapse labels in GSE128981
Grouped splits; software demo on SYNTHETIC data
Scores must not be read as probabilities
Intervention effect e is an assumption
GSE128981 is at this gate today
FastAPI /api/v1 routers · SQLAlchemy + Alembic provenance (checksums, audits, runs, model versions) · pytest suites
Nextflow runs the ML training script only; it does not orchestrate the other stages. A passing gate in code is not biological validation.
